neighbours.label: the modulo operator ' %' in code (n % i == 0), with a weaker side trigger 'Orient' in Object-Oriented
fire:
int idx = (start + step) % size;
buffer[idx] = value;

if year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0:
    leap = True
quiet:
int idx = start + step;
buffer[idx] = value;

if year > 2000 and year < 2100:
    modern = True

notes: Weak pole (max 6.9). Top: 'if(n % i == 0)', 'if a % 2 == 0', 'Object Oriented Programming'. Fire items are multi-line code using modulo; near misses use the same code with // or other operators.
